tests.description: Clicks the right camera switch button through all three rooms and wraps to the start, checking the actual 3D camera position, orientation and visible room label.
tests.name: Camera buttons - right cycle and wraparound
source: harness.assert(!!marker,'Selected room has a Camera marker');
harness.assert(!!view && near(view.x,marker.centerX) && near(view.y,marker.centerY) && near(view.z,marker.z),'Rendered 3D camera is at '+room+' viewpoint');
harness.assert(!!button && !button.hidden,'Right camera switch button is visible');

harness.assert(near(initial.x,final.x) && near(initial.y,final.y) && near(initial.z,final.z) && sameAngle(initial.angle,final.angle) && sameAngle(initial.rotationX,final.rotationX) && sameAngle(initial.rotationY,final.rotationY),'Full right cycle returns to the original position and orientation');
await harness.takeScreenshot('Right cycle returned to living room');

tests.description: Clicks the left camera switch button to wrap backward and visit all three rooms, checking actual camera position, orientation and visible room label.
tests.name: Camera buttons - left cycle and wraparound
source: harness.assert(!!marker,'Selected room has a Camera marker');
harness.assert(!!view && near(view.x,marker.centerX) && near(view.y,marker.centerY) && near(view.z,marker.z),'Rendered 3D camera is at '+room+' viewpoint');
harness.assert(!!button && !button.hidden,'Left camera switch button is visible');

harness.assert(near(initial.x,final.x) && near(initial.y,final.y) && near(initial.z,final.z) && sameAngle(initial.angle,final.angle) && sameAngle(initial.rotationX,final.rotationX) && sameAngle(initial.rotationY,final.rotationY),'Full left cycle returns to the original position and orientation');
await harness.takeScreenshot('Left cycle returned to living room');

* These are hard limits rather than performance trade-offs. three.js binds one
* texture unit per shadow map and one more for a spot light's projected

* the driver allows does not make the scene slower - the shader fails to link
* and everything using that material renders black. Only 16 fragment texture

* of those, so the budget is read from the device instead of being fixed.
